newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Jan 6.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Jan 6.

text.p: All major Mexican ports were open as of 1000 local/1600 GMT Monday, Communications and Transport Ministry said in a daily update.
Smaller boats were advised against sailing in the northern Gulf of Mexico along the coasts of Tamaulipas and Veracruz states because of a new cold front.
The ministry updated port and shipping conditions for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

A small cold front seen dissipating in the area, with cloudy skies and possible rians along the coast of the Baja California peninsula, Sonora and Sinaloa states. Dominant winds from the north and northeast at up to 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 kilometers/11 to 17 miles per hour). Winds in the Gulf of Tehuantepec were reported from the southwest at the same velocity.

A weak cold front along the northeast Gulf of Mexico from Florida seen merging with a cold front from Nebraska and moving southeast at 19 km (11 miles) per hour. Dominant winds from the north and northeast at 10 to 15 knots with waves between four and six feet high along the caost of Tamaulipas state.
Sparse rains along the coasts of Nicaragua and Honduras with winds at 10 to 15 knots.
